# Pull request

## Summary

What changed and why?

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Test / CI

## Verification

- [ ] `bun run check` passes

- [ ] I updated docs / examples where needed

## Notes

Anything reviewers should know: migration notes, trade-offs, follow-ups.
